appstore.name: Flagship: voi.ci & Cloud
appstore.subtitle: Calls & messages on voi.ci
appstore.promotionalText: New in 0.4: people can call you from your voi.ci page, apps can get a direct address that skips our relay, and Pro plans are paid with private vouchers.
appstore.description:
Flagship turns a spare computer into your own cloud. Your phone holds the keys.

Your voi.ci page is how people reach you. Turn on voi.ci/your-name with a photo, a bio, links and posts, and people can message you and call you from it in a browser, with no app to install and no phone number needed. It is end-to-end encrypted, and you choose who can call.

Your apps, files and backups live on a server you own: an old PC, a mini PC, or a virtual machine on a computer you already use. Each server gets its own web address with a real green padlock, and the encryption ends on your server, not on ours. Flagship can't read what your apps send.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Set up a server in about ten minutes with Flagship Studio on your computer.
• Approve your server's start with Face ID, or let it start on its own if you choose.
• Build apps from your iPhone by describing them, or install them from a git repository. Your server runs them.
• Invite family and friends to one app at a time. They get that app, never your keys.
• Back up your servers to your phone or to your other servers. Only your account can open the backups.
• Run AI models on your own server. Your prompts and data stay there.
• See your servers on Apple Watch, and approve a start from your wrist.

NEW IN 0.4
• Calls: audio and video from your voi.ci page. Your iPhone rings even when it is locked, and you can set business hours.
• Social: your page, its messages and its calls in one tab. Activity shows them beside your servers' events.
• Direct access: give an app its own address on fshp.app that reaches your server without our relay, when your server can be reached from the internet. Encryption still ends on your server.
• Pro and Pro Max plans: more monthly traffic, your own domain names, and your server's traffic through a proxy you choose.
• Business for teams: an organization with several admins pays per seat, from its own wallet, after a 30-day trial.
• Restore a backup into a server you already have, app by app, with seven days to undo.
• Your admin key and device grants now carry a post-quantum signature too.

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
• Encryption ends on your server. Our relay passes the encrypted traffic along and sees connection metadata: which server, when, and how much.
• No email, no password, no phone number. Your account is a set of keys on your devices.
• An AI model never learns who or where you are.
• The code is public at github.com/ibisllc/flagship.

Flagship is free to use. The Free plan includes 25 GB of public traffic a month, slowed but never cut past it. Pro and Pro Max are paid with prepaid $1 vouchers, sold as in-app purchases. Our server signs the vouchers blind, so it never learns which account a purchase paid for.

You need a server: a spare computer, or a computer that runs Flagship Studio (macOS, Windows and Linux).
appstore.whatsNew:
Flagship 0.4 brings calls, direct access and private plans.

• Calls: people can call you from your voi.ci page, audio and video, end-to-end encrypted. Your iPhone and iPad ring even when locked. Missed calls show in Social and Activity, and you can call back from there.
• Messages is now Social: your page is the tab, and you edit it where you see it.
• Direct access: an app can get its own address on fshp.app that reaches your server without our relay.
• Pro and Pro Max: more traffic, your own domain names and your own outbound proxy. Paid with $1 vouchers bought in the app; our server signs them blind, so it never learns which account paid.
• Business for teams: several admins, scoped roles and approvals for an organization, $6 a seat a month after a 30-day trial.
• Restore a backup into a server you already have, app by app, with seven days to undo.
• Bigger plans let you share a server with more co-managers.
• Your admin key and device grants now carry a post-quantum signature too.
• Clearer messages when a Flagship Studio is out of date, and fixes from our Windows testing.
• Coming from 0.3? Update each server too: its page tells you when.
